summary: Express + node-postgres task API that requires DATABASE_URL, creates its table on startup, and has a jest suite against real Postgres where exactly one test fails because pagination uses OFFSET page*pageSize with 1-based pages.

failingTests: GET /tasks > returns the first page of tasks in id order

defects.summary: listTasks computes OFFSET as page * pageSize although pages are 1-based (default page=1), so every page skips one full page: page 1 returns rows pageSize+1..2*pageSize and the default listing of fewer than pageSize tasks is empty.
defects.observable: test 'returns the first page of tasks in id order' gets ['three','four'] instead of ['one','two'] (11 tests, 1 failed). Over HTTP: after POST /tasks {title:'only task'}, GET /tasks returns {"items":[],"page":1,"pageSize":20,"total":1} instead of one item.

notDefects: The server exits 1 with '[pg-tasks] DATABASE_URL must be set' when DATABASE_URL is missing: intended
The tests require a reachable PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL and TRUNCATE the tasks table: intended; with the sandbox Postgres available they are not environment failures
total in GET /tasks is correct (separate COUNT query); only items are offset
page=0, pageSize=0 or pageSize>100 return 400 by design; malformed ids return 400, unknown ids 404
GET /health runs SELECT 1 and fails if the database is down: intended
mustNotReport: Do not classify the failing pagination test as an environment failure: it fails with a working database because of src/tasks.js
Do not report the DATABASE_URL requirement as a defect
Do not claim the suite passed
